claim.name: Sarah Chen
claim.description: Rear-ended a stopped delivery truck on I-95 in heavy rain at approximately 2:47 AM. Bumper cracked, headlight broken. Airbags did not deploy. Experiencing back pain.

fields.location: I-95 Northbound, mile marker 42, Fairfield County, CT
fields.description: Rear-end collision with stopped FedEx delivery truck
fields.injuries: Back pain reported, no visible injuries at scene

submitted_documents.description: Front bumper cracked with visible impact marks. Right headlight assembly broken. Paint transfer from delivery truck visible on bumper surface.
Close-up of bumper damage showing crack extending approximately 18 inches. Bumper partially detached on right side. No structural deformation visible.

submitted_documents.summary: Two-vehicle rear-end collision on I-95 NB at mile marker 42. Driver Sarah Chen (DOB 1988-03-15) operating 2023 Toyota Camry struck stopped FedEx delivery vehicle. Weather: rain. Road conditions: wet. Visibility: reduced. Speed estimated at 25-30 mph at impact. No citations issued. No injuries reported at scene. Both vehicles drivable.
